body: Chief addendum on P0-2 c9a2b7f (independent reviewer, 6 out-of-package probes): my two earlier REQUIRED items are CLOSED (snapshot-once fail-closed before delegation, cache.scala:81-90/195-214; .public private[embed], contract.scala:291-327). The scout's three all REPRODUCE independently: (1) AttemptReceipt.of with identical args except embeddingReceipts → equal digests, unequal receipts; a foreign ProviderCall with the real embeddingReceipts is accepted — render embeddingReceipts (kind, items/v1, outputs.render) and require providerCalls == embeddingReceipts.map(_.call) when non-empty; (2) two Withheld-with-calls paths — S2b via Embedder.conforming → addResultDecisions (182-206) → failClosed (332-359) when the key vanishes before re-receipt (kind=Withheld, providerCalls=1), and NEW S2a: a provider returning EMPTY key bytes on the cache path passes the snapshot at cache.scala:87, CacheKey.of fails as InvalidKey → Keyed.Other, public items are delegated (innerCalls=1), AttemptReceipt.of fails → failClosed → Withheld describing 1 call with the sensitive outcome Invalid(InvalidKey) while policy records key-unavailable — fix: keys.key(keyId).filter(_.nonEmpty) (or static refuses empty) AND failClosed refuses non-empty provenance; per the scout's addendum, never clear calls after a provider ran — Withheld is pre-delegation only, post-call re-receipting reuses the owned snapshot or returns a typed failure; (3) static aliases the provider's array on capture (digest.scala:85-89) — Arrays.copyOf at capture. Note the asymmetry: the cache path denies public items in a keyless mixed batch while the baseline path keeps them — pick one rule and state it (I prefer: public items proceed, non-public denied, receipt Withheld for the denied subset only if that is representable; otherwise deny all and say so in the ADR). Whoever holds the bead at 00:05Z applies exactly this list; the reviewer re-verifies the same six probes on the new SHA.
